notes: The description identifies the full-smile versus nonsmile contrast, but neither the description nor the pp. 2–3 locator specifies which of the two human-coded samples or which of the two Cox models. Table 1 prints this contrast for both samples in Model I (without covariates) and Model II (with covariates). No selection by row order, numeric matching, or PDF highlights was made. The description identifies the full-smile versus nonsmile contrast, but neither the description nor the pp. 2–3 locator specifies which of the two human-coded samples or which of the two Cox models. Table 1 prints this contrast for both samples in Model I (without covariates) and Model II (with covariates). No selection by row order, numeric matching, or PDF highlights was made. Candidate analytic model Ns are explicitly printed as 224 players (1952 sample) and 527 players (nonoverlapping replication sample). They are different analyses, not groups to sum for a single target test. Page 2 states covariates were available for all 224 cases. General source exclusions: no photographs (903), missing birth year (26), and implausibly old apparently living players (42). No contrast-specific attrition is stated. Neither candidate N is promoted to a resolved row value. Printed candidates, paired within tests: 1952 sample, Model I: b = 0.149, SE = 0.196, p = .448 (exact), HR = 1.16; 1952 sample, Model II: b = 0.114, SE = 0.200, p = .570 (exact), HR = 1.12; nonoverlapping replication sample, Model I: b = −0.240, SE = 0.146, p = .099 (exact), HR = 0.79; nonoverlapping replication sample, Model II: b = −0.197, SE = 0.148, p = .185 (exact), HR = 0.82. The source prints b (Cox regression coefficient) and HR (hazard ratio); it does not label b as standardized. No individual-contrast Wald/z/chi-square statistic is printed in Table 1. Omnibus chi-square statistics in the table note refer to models or both smile contrasts jointly and are not substitutes for the requested contrast. No metric conversion or test-statistic derivation was performed. Original side is unassigned and is only a placeholder. Source title matches assigned replication reference. PDF pages 2–4 were rendered and visually inspected; their existing highlights were not used to select a target.
